question.wording: Was this Form 1099-SA distribution used entirely for qualified medical expenses (or rolled over)?

options.label: Yes — all of it; not taxable
No — some of it was not; the taxable part is figured on Form 8889 or 8853

citation.wording: An HSA or Archer MSA distribution isn't taxable if you used it to pay qualified medical expenses of the account holder or eligible family member or you rolled it over.
